summary_text: At 2026-04-28T11:08:52+00:00, the incident telemetry recorded outbound network activity from internal host 192.168.10.210 to external IP 188.40.170.197. The destination IP was enriched as a Hetzner-hosted address with VirusTotal showing 9 malicious detections, while AbuseIPDB returned no reports and OTX showed no active pulse data. The alert payload did not include a username, hostname, operating system, process creation event, command line, or parent-child process chain, and PowerShell analysis found no decodable EncodedCommand content. The available evidence therefore consists solely of a single suspicious external connection from 192.168.10.210 to 188.40.170.197, with no confirmed endpoint execution, privilege escalation, internal movement, or data transfer artifacts in the provided record.
